in_sanskrit.name: Ayanan
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Journey, Traveler
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ayanan एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Ayanan is a Sanskrit name derived from the root word 'Ayan' meaning 'to go' or 'to travel'. This name is given to a child born on a journey or one who is destined to travel far in life. In Hindu mythology, Ayanan is also the name of a god associated with the sun and the god of travel.
